claim: Hook (PICK A, fact-check FIX 1): 'Terdakwa korupsi yang divonis 2024, kebanyakan kena dua pasal ini' rests on ICW (Wana Alamsyah, 21 Oct) monitoring of 2024 corruption verdicts: about 83% of defendants (terdakwa) divonis were sentenced under Pasal 2 and 3 UU Tipikor (first-instance and appeal verdicts, so 'terdakwa … divonis', not 'terpidana'). JawaPos: Pasal 3 1.123 + Pasal 2(1) 437 of 1.869 defendants in 2024. p2 keeps 'sekitar 83 persen … divonis tahun 2024'.
status: verified (PART 1 fact-check row 7; PART 3 fact-check FIX 1 applied)

claim: Pasal 2 & 3 UU Tipikor are being discussed in the government's study (detik 27 Oct: discussion of the articles 'berlanjut'; not 'dirumuskan ulang', weekly FIX 5). Yusril calls them 'pasal sapu jagat'.

Mon 26 Oct Yusril was called to the Palace; per Yusril, the President asked for a deeper study of the corruption definition and holds that the state-loss element must not be forgotten ('tidak boleh dilupakan'). Yusril's account only; no direct Presidential/Palace statement found.
Tue 27 Oct, Yusril received the DEN study from Luhut; per Yusril, the definition will be broadened and the state-loss element not deleted.

Ahmad Irawan (Golkar, DPR Baleg) backs the Tipikor revision and wants wider offences: trading in influence, illicit enrichment, under-invoicing (script names only under-invoicing; caption lists all three).
status: verified (weekly d7, E0362; single detik source, RMOL headline agrees)

claim: Earlier (21–22 Oct) the KPK chair (Setyo Budiyanto), ICW and two PKS politicians objected to removing the state-loss element. Script wording: 'keberatan kalau kerugian negara dihapus' (conditional, since Luhut later clarified he did not propose removing it).

Legal analyst Hardjuno Wiwoho (statement Sat 24 Oct) said protection for business decisions must not become a loophole to avoid accountability ('celah untuk menghindari pertanggungjawaban'). A cautionary note, not an objector. Shown as a neutral 'catatan' chip.
It is still a study: no draft RUU announced and the revision is not in Prolegnas.

Since the new KUHP took effect on 2 Jan 2026, KUHP Pasal 622 revoked UU Tipikor Pasal 2(1) and 3 and moved them to KUHP Pasal 603 and 604, which keep the state-finance-loss element. Spoken: 'Sejak Januari, isinya pindah ke KUHP baru. Unsur kerugian negaranya tetap ada.' (603/604 only in the caption).

Pak Budi is a fictional illustration (on-screen 'misalnya' chip). hb1 'Selasa pagi, Pak Budi baca berita: aturan korupsi dikaji ulang' (Tue 27 Oct = day of the DEN study handover, l4); 'dikaji ulang' = the government study above; hb2 'dipersempit atau diperluas' is a question, answered by l4 (Yusril: diperluas).
